usage: 鍋貼 can be used as a noun referring to a type of pan-fried dumpling.
When talking about food, 鍋貼 is often combined with other dim sum items.
You can use 鍋貼 to order or describe this dish in restaurants.
鍋貼 is countable, so you can say how many pieces you want.
In a sentence, 鍋貼 usually comes after a verb related to eating or cooking.
